name: Side Hop Carousel
description: Full-screen horizontal scroll-snap carousel driven by CSS scroll timelines. Each slide image grows from a small clipped card to full bleed while eyebrow, title and description animate in.
contents: Optional header with heading and rule
Description, numbered page indicator with progress bar, eyebrow and large serif title per slide
Fallback message for browsers without scroll-driven animations
behavior: Horizontal scroll-snap track drives all animation through CSS scroll and view timelines
Images grow from a clipped, scaled card to full bleed and then zoom slightly
Texts slide and skew in at the centre of each slide and fade out
Page numbers are anchor links that jump to a slide
Shows only the fallback text where scroll-driven animations are unsupported

props.name: fallbackText
props.default: This browser does not support scroll-driven animations.

editableByProps: Slides: images, eyebrows, titles, emphasized words, descriptions
Background and text colors, heading, visibility of header, eyebrow, description and indicator
Slide sizing and the grow animation parameters, title size, fonts, fallback text

needsCodeEdit.change: Add a custom header content such as links

fixed: Relies on CSS scroll-driven animations and timeline-scope, other browsers see the fallback text
Fonts are not loaded by the component, the host page must provide Cardo and Inter or the fallbacks are used
Fills at least the viewport height
